name: tailscale-menu
title: TailscaleMenu
description: The Tailscale connection as a menu, for a popover or a menu-bar extra: where you are connected (tailnet and this device), the exit node chooser and sign out, over useTailscale. The exit nodes read as a radio list or as a list of networks like macOS's Wi-Fi menu (a check for the one in use, a trailing glyph, Connecting…, offline devices dimmed, None at the top). The parts (TailscaleMenuSummary, TailscaleExitNodes) are exported to build your own.
